name_i18n.en: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj fee concession (Maharashtra)

summary_i18n.en: Pays part or all of the fees for students in professional courses whose family income is up to Rs 8 lakh.

source_title: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojana, Directorate of Technical Education, Maharashtra (page updated 20 November 2025)

label_i18n.en: Both parents' yearly income together is Rs 8 lakh or less

note_i18n.en: Half of the fees for boys and all of the fees for girls (from 2024-25). Apply on the MahaDBT portal while you are enrolled.

research_note: READ in full on 2026-11-19 (page fetched): family income up to Rs 8 lakh (both parents together), professional courses, 50% of fees for male and 100% for female students from 2024-25, apply on MahaDBT. The page does not state domicile, a child limit or documents. MahaDBT listings (seen in search excerpts only) mention Maharashtra domicile, CAP admission and two children per family: these are NOT used until read on MahaDBT. Which courses count as professional is not spelled out on the page.
